title: The Charter Factor
openingText: Verrick has your name, your last three contracts, and an opening price, all of them written down before you sat. 'I price people the way I price freight,' she says, not unkindly. 'By what it costs me if you go missing. Shall we?'
dialogueWalkaway: Then we are done. I will note the terms you refused, for next time.
dialogueAccept: Signed and sealed. You will find the Charter honours its paper, which is more than most here can say.
confidence: The handling charge is not hers. The Charter skims it, and she has been told to collect.

clauses.text: Charter outriders see your column through the canal-road towns unmolested.
Verrick buys 20 of your supplies at works rates: 70 gold on the spot.
A provisional Charter seal: tolls waived at three gatehouses this season.
You agree not to sell the same intelligence to any rival guild. Enforceable.
An 'assay and handling' charge she has not mentioned aloud.
Their trade charts: every road and ford their factors use
Your column rides escort for their next shipment
